definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese room with tatami mat flooring, typically featuring fusuma (sliding doors) and a tokonoma (alcove).

examples.english: To spend time in a Japanese-style room.

examples.japanese: この{旅館|りょかん}には{和室|わしつ}と{洋室|ようしつ}がある。
examples.english: This inn has both Japanese-style and Western-style rooms.

examples.japanese: {畳|たたみ}の{和室|わしつ}は{落|お}ち{着|つ}いた{雰囲気|ふんいき}がある。
examples.english: A Japanese-style room with tatami has a calming atmosphere.

notes:
{和室|わしつ} is composed of {和|わ} (Japanese) + {室|しつ} (room).

CONTRASTING WORDS:
- {和室|わしつ}: Japanese-style room (tatami, sliding doors)
- {洋室|ようしつ}: Western-style room (flooring, beds)
